payload.summary: Planned the code-search upstream dependency upgrade requested via dependabot #730/#693. Research showed cocoindex 1.1.x is unsatisfiable with every released cocoindex-code (all cap cocoindex<1.1.0) and that cocoindex-code 0.2.42 forces pathspec 0.12.1, under which IndexingPolicy deny rules fail open for newline-named paths. Selected approach: upgrade inside the 1.0 window (cocoindex-code 0.2.42, cocoindex 1.0.26), fix the matcher, keep D8 with a coupling-rule amendment, defer 1.1 behind a recorded trigger. Tier sequential (coordinator unreachable); discovery and both gates auto-defaulted because the operator was not interactively available.

decisions.title: Keep D8 hard pin; move window to cocoindex>=1.0.17,<1.1.0 + cocoindex-code==0.2.42
decisions.rationale: Every pinned version is one upstream declares compatible; D8 rationale unchanged

decisions.title: Amend D8 with a coupling rule enforced from uv.lock
decisions.rationale: cocoindex window must not exceed the pinned cocoindex-code's declared cocoindex range; would have rejected #730 mechanically

decisions.title: Policy matching must be pathspec-major-independent
decisions.rationale: pathspec 0.12 '**' does not match '\n'; deny rules fail open while includes still match

decisions.title: Defer cocoindex 1.1 until a cocoindex-code release admits >=1.1.1
decisions.rationale: Unsatisfiable today; 1.1.0 excluded for memo target-state loss fixed in 1.1.1 (#2660)

next_steps: Task 1.1: RED policy tests for newline/tab paths under pathspec 0.12.1
